metadata.capacity_source: portmiami_vessel_master.json (one record per ship; see each call's passenger_capacity_source)
metadata.itinerary_source: Previously supplied partial November sailing schedule, November 18-30
data_notes: Dock Report covers November 1-30 but not necessarily every vessel movement at the port.
Dock report records are not equivalent to unique voyage departures or passenger embarkations.
No capacity is invented or inferred from tonnage or vessel length.
Terminal AAA is retained as printed in the Dock Report, not silently remapped to AA.
Voyage options are attached only for exact matching ship and departure date.

passenger_capacity is set only for calls whose capacity is validated (verified source, double-occupancy / lower-berth definition). published_capacity keeps any figure found, with capacity_type and capacity_status.
Passenger capacity is a ship capacity, not a count of passengers on a sailing.
metadata.previous_capacity_source: User-provided Carnival Corporation fleet report (2026-05-31) via existing cruise JSON
